title: Get a Conversation ID for support
subtitle: Run the right debug command, capture the ID, and send support the session details.

steps.title: Enter the debug command
steps.evidence: Type /debug conversationid in the chat; the agent displays the Conversation ID for that specific session.

steps.title: Capture the Conversation ID
steps.evidence: Type /debug in Microsoft 365 Copilot; the declarative agent shows a debugging card that includes the Conversation ID.

steps.title: Send support the full context
steps.evidence: Include the Conversation ID, where and when you used the agent, and what you expected compared with what happened.
